addicted_vr: Day 10. The corporal put Casimir Addicted beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

A shell landed close to U-F7. When the dust settled Casimir Addicted was still there, holding a tin of tobacco, laughing without sound. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F7. Casimir Addicted has learned to walk bent double.
Casimir Addicted woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
Casimir Addicted raised his head for a heartbeat too long at U-F7. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Bastian Deltascourge of the Hegemony (@deltascourge1).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Casimir Addicted is whole again, or near enough for the line.

A bullet hit Casimir Addicted in the neck at U-F7. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10). Casimir Addicted looked over the parapet at U-F7 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10).
A letter came with Henrik Addicted: "I am Casimir Addicted's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Henrik Addicted did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Henrik Addicted fired back. Lucien S was grazed.
Henrik Addicted had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jakub Patrickktz crossed it, Henrik Addicted fired. Jakub Patrickktz was badly wounded.
bladestalker333: Valentin Bladestalker reported to S-F1 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Valentin Bladestalker kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. Victory at Hill 304. Valentin Bladestalker let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F1 and grazed Valentin Bladestalker's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Anselm Alexj of the Concord (@alexj.558).
The medics cleaned Valentin Bladestalker's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F1.
Valentin Bladestalker traded a frozen apple for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Valentin Bladestalker hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.

Valentin Bladestalker reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F1 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Marek "Owl" Schu of the Concord (@zde_schu). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Valentin Bladestalker during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Valentin Bladestalker tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Valentin Bladestalker is number 336. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Valentin Bladestalker shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The medics would not give up on Valentin Bladestalker. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F1 today.
Valentin Bladestalker sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
Valentin Bladestalker and Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil found a cat in the ruins at Hill 304 and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Ghost.
An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Valentin Bladestalker only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last.

Valentin Bladestalker had just lit a cigarette at S-F1 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Nils "Spark" Azok of the Concord (@azok_78046).
Valentin Bladestalker came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
bubonicplague05: Tobias Bubonicplagu told the sergeant he was a ferryman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
A bullet grazed Tobias Bubonicplagu's ribs at N-F20. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Norbert Jaze of the Concord (@jaze96).
Tobias Bubonicplagu tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
chase.c109: Marek "Lucky" Chase, a clockmaker from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 7 to fill a gap in R-S5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
At Hill 304, Marek "Lucky" Chase and Wendel Jesus exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Officers came to inspect R-S5. Marek "Lucky" Chase polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

The raid was quick, the way back was not. Marek "Lucky" Chase snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Marek "Lucky" Chase free. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Marek "Lucky" Chase read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A round came through the loophole Marek "Lucky" Chase was watching at R-S5 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Dorian Heitoralmeid of the Hegemony (@heitoralmeida314). The clerk counted the names twice. Marek "Lucky" Chase is number 489 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Marek "Lucky" Chase wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
No bed for Marek "Lucky" Chase yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Marek "Lucky" Chase healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Marek "Lucky" Chase carried three men out of R-S5 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Marek "Lucky" Chase across the shin at R-S5. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann).
Marek "Lucky" Chase no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Marek "Lucky" Chase's ear at R-S5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Silas Branden of the Hegemony (@branden_l10).
dmptrk3: Viktor Dmptrk arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Viktor Dmptrk helped stack spare sandbags at T-F16. Nobody asked when they would be needed. Orders came through: Viktor Dmptrk is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

Viktor Dmptrk and Ivo Jeff divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Viktor Dmptrk looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Viktor Dmptrk took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at T-F16, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke of the Hegemony (@logancooke97). Across from T-F16, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Viktor Dmptrk saw it. Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke was badly wounded.
Viktor Dmptrk spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Viktor Dmptrk recovered anyway and is back at T-F16.
Viktor Dmptrk measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Viktor Dmptrk put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Viktor Dmptrk waited for the password before answering.
doddski555: Marek Doddski came from Greyhallow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
donnyredd: "You're late," said the corporal when Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd arrived on Day 6. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd left the work of a runner to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd and Jakub Hans carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. A letter from home reached Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd before dusk. Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd read it twice and slept a little easier.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.
A parcel from home held a comb. Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

A bullet went through Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd's sleeve at R-S9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Severin Nonly of the Hegemony (@leopoldda1nonly). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd rejoined the squad at R-S9. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd answered to number 378. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.
Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

The men at R-S9 heard Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Leopold Kapitancray of the Hegemony (@kapitancray). Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd was killed outright at R-S9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Leopold Kapitancray of the Hegemony (@kapitancray).
Silas Donnyredd arrived carrying the family name of Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Silas Donnyredd raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-S9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Emil "Button" Mugginsthede of the Hegemony (@mugginsthedestroyer).
fresh.sprite: Jakub "Lucky" Sprite signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C6 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Jakub "Lucky" Sprite folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Jakub "Lucky" Sprite pulled Quentin "Crow" Alpharius out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jakub "Lucky" Sprite is number 720. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Jakub "Lucky" Sprite watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Jakub "Lucky" Sprite took the long way round the Ossuary Wood because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Jakub "Lucky" Sprite said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Jakub "Lucky" Sprite began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
A new trench junction cost Jakub "Lucky" Sprite ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
The reply to Jakub "Lucky" Sprite's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Jakub "Lucky" Sprite asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn.
glenn.st_john: Anselm "Ash" John came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Second Lieutenant and pointed at the mud.
Anselm "Ash" John hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
A man asked Anselm "Ash" John to describe Greyhallow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
A bullet clipped Anselm "Ash" John's helmet at V-F2 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Bastian Salvib of the Hegemony (@salvib0ss).
The medic cut the last bandage off Anselm "Ash" John's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to V-F2 the same hour.
gunnar_durham2325: Benedikt Durham took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Benedikt Durham became a runner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Orders assigned Benedikt Durham to work as a chaplain. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Benedikt Durham and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.

Rumour reached R-F15 that the war would be over by spring. Benedikt Durham has heard it before. So has everyone. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Benedikt Durham folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Benedikt Durham and Gideon Actioncam divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Benedikt Durham asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Durham taught Gideon Actioncam to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F15. Benedikt Durham has learned to walk bent double.
Benedikt Durham found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.

Benedikt Durham offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Benedikt Durham. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Benedikt Durham. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Benedikt Durham only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F15, then nothing but pain. Raider: Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Durham kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier.

Back on the fire step at R-F15. Benedikt Durham says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt Durham answered to number 106. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Durham watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
the Parson the crow follows Benedikt Durham along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Benedikt Durham was hit hard at Blackwater Canal. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin.
The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Benedikt Durham. He was asleep before they set him down.
Benedikt Durham returned to R-F15 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Benedikt Durham was hit hard in the fight at R-F15 before anyone could fire. The raider was Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald of the Hegemony. Raider: Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald of the Hegemony (@aubrey.macdonald).
A round came through the loophole Benedikt Durham was watching at R-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz).
inexactjupiter: Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R9 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit was carrying water up to S-R9 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit did not. Shot by Gideon Dominicktheb of the Concord (@dominickthebombinick25). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-R9, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit of the Hegemony and Wendel Schwols of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Sunken Road all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
A bullet found Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit at S-R9, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Gideon Dominicktheb of the Concord (@dominickthebombinick25).
A medic brought Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
There was never a bed for Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-R9 on his own feet.
k1ngj24: On Day 8, Valentin Ngj arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Valentin Ngj buried two men at the edge of the Chalk Pits and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Valentin Ngj wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Valentin Ngj offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last. The clerk counted the names twice. Valentin Ngj is number 597 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Valentin Ngj stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Zeno Matteozrybak of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin Ngj kept the tin.
Valentin Ngj (Concord) watched Severin Polipoart (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Hanging Bridge, and held fire until both were gone.
Valentin Ngj drew a map of Emil Nayam's hometown from Emil's stories. Emil says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Valentin Ngj helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Valentin Ngj said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

Valentin Ngj was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-S1. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n). Valentin Ngj was hit at S-S1 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n).
The House of Ngj sent Zeno Ngj after Valentin Ngj. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
krokous21: Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-C10 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-C10. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous fired at the last man to run. Silas Heffy was grazed. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous before dusk. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous read it twice and slept a little easier.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous aimed just below it. Isidor Glc was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous before dusk. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous read it twice and slept a little easier. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 755. The men who came later will ask about it. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous fired, and Matthias Covonarson was badly wounded.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.

Emil "Spark" Austin of the Concord shouted across the wire at Verdel Ridge, asking for the football scores from home. Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous of the Hegemony shouted them back. Some of them were even true.
Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Arno Broccoli, gravely wounded.
ky_the_caique: Norbert Caique came up the line with a pocket Bible with a hole in it and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Norbert Caique went out with the wiring party at V-F17. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Norbert Caique had just lit a cigarette at V-F17 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Henrik "Mole" Vinelord of the Concord (@vinelord_). A letter from home reached Norbert Caique before dusk. Norbert Caique read it twice and slept a little easier.
The medics cleaned Norbert Caique's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at V-F17.

Norbert Caique was found at the bottom of the trench at V-F17, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Edmund Jackson of the Concord (@robbie_jackson420). A single shot at V-F17. Norbert Caique sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Edmund Jackson of the Concord (@robbie_jackson420).
The papers connected Bram Caique to Norbert Caique. The men took longer to learn Bram Caique's own habits, but they made the effort.
Bram Caique reads Ivo Omombintaro's letters from home out loud, because Ivo never learned to read. Bram leaves out the sad parts. Ivo knows.
lewis_fitness99: Florian Fitness found a place in Q-F5 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy (Concord) and Florian Fitness (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Sorrow Copse. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Florian Fitness helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Arno Passenger lent Florian Fitness a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Jonas Breadwards cut Florian Fitness's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Florian Fitness tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at Q-F5 is up.
Florian Fitness wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Florian Fitness used it. Roland Lesyk was gravely wounded.
On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Florian Fitness was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
Three days with a bandage, and Florian Fitness is back at Q-F5. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
lonnor_cake: The draft reached R-C5 on Day 9. Dietrich "Button" Cake was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Dietrich "Button" Cake fired once through the steel loophole at R-C5 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Rafael Szy was grazed. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Dietrich "Button" Cake wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Dietrich "Button" Cake moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long. Dietrich "Button" Cake got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 767. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich "Button" Cake wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The parcel for Dietrich "Button" Cake contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Dietrich "Button" Cake gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Dietrich "Button" Cake and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Dietrich "Button" Cake fired. Felix Yummygraingo was gravely wounded.
Anselm "Brick" Squid saw Dietrich "Button" Cake freeze up on the fire step at the Brickworks. Brick said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
The last report placed Dietrich "Button" Cake near Lantern Hill. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing.
A patrol went out looking for Dietrich "Button" Cake last night and came back with a torn glove. Nobody is sure it was his.
masonpicco06062007: Emil Masonpicco arrived on Day 15 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Emil Masonpicco traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Emil Masonpicco and Arno Neverheavyen share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
max.kattawar: Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.

Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at R-F7 changed before the cheering ended. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar shouldered another load.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F7 and grazed Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu).
The medics cleaned Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F7.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar approved the method. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F7 with the rations. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar ate while listening to the revised orders.

Dawn watch. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Casimir Sky, grazed. Shrapnel at Sorrow Copse. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar snores. Benedikt Durham does not. Benedikt now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar ate two helpings anyway.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F7. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Arno "Doc" As of the Hegemony (@a.s26221).
Lucien Kattawar arrived carrying the family name of Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Lucien Kattawar fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Teodor "Doc" Rley, now grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Lucien Kattawar is number 133 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Lucien Kattawar heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Lucien Kattawar across the shin at R-F7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44).
Lucien Kattawar is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Lucien Kattawar spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Lucien Kattawar had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Hugo Kazyutheaval, badly wounded.
Lucien Kattawar was on watch at R-F7 when the night raid hit. The men found Lucien Kattawar at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Otto Tyner of the Hegemony (@tyner_1776).
The papers say Jakub "Ghost" Kattawar. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Lucien Kattawar's eyes. Nobody in R-F7 argues.
Jakub "Ghost" Kattawar of the Concord and Casimir Jcsv of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Lantern Hill all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
nikt128f: Leopold "Parson" Nikt, a schoolteacher from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 15 to fill a gap in V-F20. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

A bullet hit Leopold "Parson" Nikt in the neck at V-F20. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Edmund Titan of the Concord (@thechief_titan). Leopold "Parson" Nikt was killed at V-F20 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Edmund Titan of the Concord (@thechief_titan).
Albin "Hollow" Nikt took the same post at V-F20 where Leopold "Parson" Nikt stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Albin "Hollow" Nikt borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
noahmcelheran: The new rifleman gave his name as Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. After what happened at the Bone Quarry, Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera asked to serve as a runner. Nobody argued.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home reached Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera before dusk. Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera thought about a younger sister who sends drawings on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
A round went through Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc).
Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.
Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
par_pars_: By the time Arno Pars reached P-F20, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Arno Pars added a leak above the man's head in pencil. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Arno Pars watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A bullet hit Arno Pars's belt buckle at P-F20 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Hugo Plhubs of the Hegemony (@plhubs).
Arno Pars no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Arno Pars lost a boot in the trench. Hugo "Shadow" Logan found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.

A bullet struck Arno Pars below the ribs at P-F20. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Silas "Parson" Burnhill of the Hegemony (@jacob.burnhill). A single shot at P-F20. Arno Pars sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Silas "Parson" Burnhill of the Hegemony (@jacob.burnhill).
The House of Pars sent Albin "Mole" Pars after Arno Pars. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Albin "Mole" Pars spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction.
Fresh from training, Albin "Mole" Pars still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Matthias Coop, badly wounded.
pcampbellsmith: The quartermaster asked Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi was hit in the forearm at U-F14. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz). After the loss of Grey Mill, Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi helped stack spare sandbags at U-F14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi in the open at U-F14. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829). The bearers reached Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi at U-F14 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829).
The papers connected Nils Pcampbellsmi to Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi. The men took longer to learn Nils Pcampbellsmi's own habits, but they made the effort.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Nils Pcampbellsmi said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
A shell hit the latrine at U-F14. Nobody was hurt. Nils Pcampbellsmi says it was the best day of the war.
Nils Pcampbellsmi was hit in the hip at U-F14. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel).
The bearers moved Nils Pcampbellsmi's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
There was never a bed for Nils Pcampbellsmi, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to U-F14 on his own feet.
platinum_alboum: Karel "Owl" Alboum unpacked a tin whistle at N-F11. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Karel "Owl" Alboum's bunk. He has named it Margarethe.
Karel "Owl" Alboum and Wendel Gers both swear they saw a ghost at Blackwater Canal. Each says the other screamed first.
Karel "Owl" Alboum shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Margarethe the rat now waits for Karel "Owl" Alboum at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Margarethe ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Karel "Owl" Alboum followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Margarethe his life.
samuel_ols45: Edmund Ols, a coal miner from Varenne, was sent forward on Day 13 to fill a gap in V-F22. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Konrad Dominicankng mended the hole in Edmund Ols's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Edmund says the patch is stronger than the trousers.

The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Edmund Ols and two others formed a very irritated windbreak. A letter from home found Edmund Ols before the night shift. Edmund Ols folded it small and kept it close.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Edmund Ols dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Viktor Gunny coming out. It was over in seconds. (@gunny1717) Edmund Ols went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Edmund Ols on the wire, halfway home. Killed in the night raid by Karel Michaelamice of the Hegemony (@michaelamice).
Matthias "Brick" Ols put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Edmund Ols helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Ulrich Hodnepijumal of the Hegemony and Matthias "Brick" Ols of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Lantern Hill for a week. Both trenches keep score. Matthias "Brick" Ols found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Matthias "Brick" Ols read it while the kettle boiled.
yoi.photo: Nils Photo reached S-F8 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A bullet found Nils Photo at S-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Rafael "Bones" Gaita of the Hegemony (@gaita_4119). Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Nils Photo could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Nils Photo spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should.
Nils Photo never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Nils Photo called across from the Concord line. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Nils Photo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A parcel came for Nils Photo that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott and Nils Photo compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Fresh from training, Nils Photo still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Rafael "Bones" Gaita, grazed.

Nils Photo fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F8. Walter Ice was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Nils Photo counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Wendel Roma was gravely wounded.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F8. Nils Photo has learned to walk bent double.

The parcel's address was smudged. Nils Photo took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Photo is number 101 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-F8 with the rations. Nils Photo ate while listening to the revised orders.
Nils Photo borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Nils Photo caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Nils Photo helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Nils Photo's ear at S-F8 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Lucien Somehowballi of the Hegemony (@somehowballin).
Nils Photo no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Nils Photo smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Wendel Chloe came out for a cup and was grazed.
zachbutler27: On Day 13, Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler used it. Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada was badly wounded. A single shot from across the wire hit Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler in the thigh at N-F8. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada of the Concord (@camiloalmadalopez). A single shot at N-F8. Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada of the Concord (@camiloalmadalopez).
The papers say Silas "Hollow" Zachbutler. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Jonas "Lucky" Zachbutler's eyes. Nobody in N-F8 argues.

A bullet went into Silas "Hollow" Zachbutler's chest just under the heart at N-F8. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Gustav Rillo of the Concord (@andrewp3rillo). Silas "Hollow" Zachbutler was killed outright at N-F8, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gustav Rillo of the Concord (@andrewp3rillo).
The House of Zachbutler sent another. Leopold Zachbutler, uncle of Silas "Hollow" Zachbutler, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Leopold Zachbutler saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

Leopold Zachbutler moved to a new hide at N-F8 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Severin "Mud" Notbrayden, grazed. Leopold Zachbutler had just lit a cigarette at N-F8 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Konrad Lbz of the Concord (@lbz.z1p).
